why: Part (d) asks how the int division 5 / z differs from 1.0 / 0. The answer says without qualification that dividing by zero gives an error, but the run shows 1.0 / 0 printing Infinity, so this matches the ZeroDivisionAlwaysCrashes misconception.

concepts.quote: Dividing by zero gives an error.
concepts.why: It treats every division by zero as an error, but only int / and % by zero throw; 1.0 / 0 gives Infinity, as the run output shows.
